function select<T extends { x: number; y: string }>(value: T['x']): T['x' | 'y'] { return value; }
function narrow<T extends { x: number; y: string }>(value: T[keyof T]): T['x'] { return value; }
function wrong<T extends { x: number; y: string }>(value: T['y']): T['x'] { return value; }
function pick<T extends {x: number, y: string}, K extends keyof T, L extends K>(value: T[L]): T['x' | 'y'] { return value; }
function derivedLookup<T extends {x: number, y: string}, U extends T, K extends keyof T, L extends K & keyof U>(value: U[L]): T['x' | 'y'] { return value; }
function only<T extends {x: number, y: number}, K extends keyof T, L extends K>(value: T[L]): T['x'] { return value; }
